newsitem.title: GERMANY: TNT opens Hanover distribution hub.
newsitem.headline: TNT opens Hanover distribution hub.

text.p: TNT Express GmbH, the domestic German express arm of global integrator TNT, said it has opened a new Hanover distribution hub.
Its associated company GD Express Worldwide, responsible for air express transport, would also use the premises, a company statement said.
The 12 million marks terminal covered 19,000 square metres, including 4,000 square metres of storage and 80 docking points for trucks and vans, and employed 120 staff.
TNT manager Wolfgang Albeck said the main feature of the new terminal was a fully-automatic rapid sorting machine for parcels, documents and post.

Together with hubs at Frankfurt and Nuremberg, the new terminal would allow later client collection and early distribution times, he added. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
